state_contract.places_action: Visible in the existing map-header action family with aria-expanded=false and aria-controls=explorer-panel-dock; panel absent.
state_contract.panel: No desktop reservation and no mobile sheet until the action is used.
state_contract.focus: Normal map/header order; Places is a native 44px button.
state_contract.history: Opening remains ephemeral and creates no URL write.

state_contract.places_action: The visible trigger exposes aria-expanded=true and aria-controls=explorer-panel-dock. Reactivating it toggles the panel closed and deterministically leaves focus on the trigger.
state_contract.panel: The dock id is explorer-panel-dock; title is exactly Places; native select is first meaningful field; desktop reserves 400px only while open; compact layouts expand the existing sheet.
state_contract.focus: Opening focuses the native select. Panel Close restores the Places trigger; trigger reactivation closes and retains trigger focus.
state_contract.history: Opening is a disclosure state, not a new route and creates no history entry. Browser popstate closes the disclosure before hydrating canonical atlas state.

state_contract.places_action: The shared closePlaces helper clears the disclosure without restoring trigger focus before handleSelect runs; no second selected state is created.
state_contract.panel: The same dock changes to the existing selected-place detail; compact detail returns to the existing collapsed-sheet default.
state_contract.focus: After the select change, focus moves to the existing panel Close control so the removed select cannot strand focus.
state_contract.history: Selection calls handleSelect; neutral selection therefore uses the existing place pushState path.

state_contract.state: canonical transition away from neutral Places host
state_contract.places_action: One local closePlaces helper clears placesOpen before map/handleSelect, score, Data coverage, Rank ranges, 2030 stress test, Guided tour, Methods, and popstate/Back-Forward transitions. No state machine is added.
state_contract.panel: The Places panel cannot reappear when a later transition returns to a compatible shell; destination-selected, diagnostic, guided, and Methods surfaces retain ownership.
state_contract.focus: Transition-driven clearing does not restore the Places trigger. Each destination keeps its existing focus behavior; selected disclosure activation explicitly focuses the selected panel Close control.
state_contract.history: The helper does not write history. Popstate calls it before parse/hydration; all existing pushState/replaceState ownership remains unchanged.

state_contract.panel: Existing selected detail and title render unchanged.

state_contract.places_action: Hidden while a diagnostic or selected panel owns the dock; Close to neutral makes it visible again.
state_contract.panel: Existing Data coverage/Rank ranges root and contextual child Back behavior remain unchanged.
state_contract.focus: Existing diagnostic Back/Close restoration remains unchanged.
state_contract.history: Existing diagnostic replaceState path remains unchanged.

state_contract.state: loading, data error, or zero loaded records
state_contract.places_action: Absent because the current app-state gate owns the viewport before the Explore shell mounts.
state_contract.panel: No empty picker or invented recovery UI.
state_contract.focus: No disabled or empty control enters the order.
state_contract.history: No change. A future distinct empty-data state may disable/omit the action, but TASK-118 must not redefine the app-wide loader.

responsive_contract.desktop: Header remains 160px; keep the neutral map full width and reserve the existing 400px dock only after Places is activated.
responsive_contract.portrait: The third action wraps the header from 158px to 209px (+51px), still 30px shorter than the permanent-select concept at 239px. Use the existing expanded bottom sheet for the picker, with native select and Close visible without horizontal scrolling.
responsive_contract.landscape: Header remains 145px. Use the existing full-width sheet and permit body scrolling inside it; do not add a second drawer or permanent header field.
responsive_contract.floor_320px: The third action wraps the header from 158px to 209px (+51px), still 30px shorter than the permanent-select concept at 239px. Keep button/select/Close at least 44px, allow long option names to use native platform presentation, and retain zero page horizontal overflow.

semantics.ordering: Alphabetical order is for retrieval only and has no analytical, priority, ranking, preparedness, need, readiness, or vulnerability meaning.
semantics.data: Options come only from loaded stable Geo code/name pairs.
semantics.selection: Every activation clears placesOpen then ends at handleSelect; every other canonical transition away clears the same disclosure through one local helper. No alternate selected code, URL writer, state machine, camera controller, or panel stack.
